text.en:
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
.
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
